applicability_reason: no analog blocks detected in the input documents — digital-only IC; the analog interface spec layer is not applicable and is intentionally left empty
signaling_summary: Per-lane NVHS (NVIDIA High-Speed) low-voltage differential signaling on TX and RX differential pairs. Lanes are grouped into a sub-link ('brick' = 8 differential lane pairs per direction). NVLink 1.0-3.0 use two-level NRZ; NVLink 4.0 (Hopper / H100) uses four-level PAM4. The embedded clock is recovered by the receiver CDR from the serial stream. Per direction per link is 25 GB/s (Gen2-4); 18 links on H100 aggregate to 900 GB/s bidirectional.
modulation: NRZ (two-level) for NVLink 1.0-3.0; PAM4 (four-level) for NVLink 4.0.

transmitter_specs_canonical.equalization: Transmitter equalization (FFE / de-emphasis) to open the eye at the NVHS line rate; required for PAM4 at Gen4.
transmitter_specs_canonical.transmitter_disabled_state: Electrical idle when the link is in a low-power / down state.

receiver_specs_canonical.ctle_dfe: CTLE + DFE receiver equalization to open the eye; PAM4 (Gen4) requires a four-level slicer + stronger DFE.
receiver_specs_canonical.cdr: Clock/data recovery extracts the embedded clock from the serial stream.
receiver_specs_canonical.lane_alignment: Per-sub-link lane de-skew aligns the 8 lane pairs before flit reassembly.

modulation_evolution.NVLink_4_0: PAM4 (Hopper / H100) — four-level modulation doubles bits/symbol vs NRZ at a given baud.

sub_link_brick.definition: A sub-link ('brick') is 8 differential lane pairs per direction.
sub_link_brick.aggregation: Multiple links (each a TX+RX sub-link pair) are aggregated per GPU: 4 (P100) / 6 (V100) / 12 (A100) / 18 (H100).

encoding_role_in_analog: NVHS line encoding/scrambling provides DC balance and transition density so the receiver CDR can lock; at Gen4 PAM4 packs 2 bits/symbol, requiring tighter equalization and a four-level receiver slicer to keep the three eyes open.

c2c_interface.NVLink_C2C: Die-to-die / chip-to-chip physical layer (e.g. Grace-Hopper) tuned for short on-package reach, cache-coherent at the protocol level.
